result.final_answer:
I have successfully found solar-powered LED garden lights on Amazon that meet all the criteria. Here are the best matches:

## Solar-Powered Garden Lights (LED, Packs of 10+, Under $50)

### 1. INCX Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof, 12 Pack Ground Lights
- **Title**: INCX Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof, Cold White, 12 Pack Ground Lights | Solar Powered Lights Outdoor Solar Disk Light Landscape Light for Deck Step Patio Yard Pathway Walkway Driveway Garden
- **Price**: $27.99 (originally $37.99 — 26% off) → ~$2.33 per light
- **Pack Size**: 12 lights
- **Light Type**: LED (Solar Powered)
- **Rating**: 4.4 stars (13,391 reviews), Amazon's Choice
- **URL**: https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B07VPTBXXL/

### 2. INCX Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof, 16 Pack Ground Lights
- **Title**: INCX Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof, Cold White, 16 Pack Ground Lights | Solar Powered Lights Outdoor Solar Disk Light Landscape Light for Deck Step Patio Yard Pathway Walkway Driveway Garden
- **Price**: $35.99 → ~$2.25 per light
- **Pack Size**: 16 lights
- **Light Type**: LED (Solar Powered)
- **Rating**: 4.5 stars (677 reviews)
- **URL**: https://www.amazon.com/gp/aw/d/B0DTP5G37L/

### 3. GIGALUMI Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof, 12 Pack, LED Garden Decor
- **Title**: GIGALUMI Solar Lights Outdoor Waterproof 12 Pack, LED Garden Decor
- **Price**: $23.99 (list $31.99) → ~$2.00 per light
- **Pack Size**: 12 lights
- **Light Type**: LED (Solar Powered), Warm White
- **Rating**: 4.1 stars (18,114 reviews)
- **URL**: https://www.amazon.com/s?k=solar+garden+lights+LED+pack+of+10

All three products are **solar-powered**, use **LED lights**, come in **packs of 10 or more** (12 or 16 lights), and are priced **under $50**. The **GIGALUMI 12 Pack** offers the best value per light, while the **INCX 16 Pack** gives you the most lights for under $50.
